TIPS.T4: Lab catalog supports auto-flag — the system will mark critical results automatically.

TIPS.T8: System supports 3 languages: switch in the top right corner.

ADMIN.TITLE: Administrator account
ADMIN.DESC: Create the main account to manage the system

ADMIN.INTRO: The Administrator is the master role in the system with full access to all modules.
ADMIN.SEC1_DESC: The Staff section (/staff) provides a complete overview of all employees:
ADMIN.SEC1_ITEM1: 4 KPI cards: total, active, inactive, doctors
ADMIN.SEC1_ITEM2: Top-5 activity chart for the week
ADMIN.SEC2_DESC: The Rooms section (/rooms) covers all physical clinic rooms:
ADMIN.SEC3_DESC: In /lab/catalog create tests with full parameters:
ADMIN.SEC3_ITEM3: Parameters with reference ranges for auto-flagging
ADMIN.SEC4_DESC: The Reports section (/reports) provides clinic analytics:
ADMIN.TIP1: Create staff accounts before setting up rooms — doctors must exist before they can be assigned to rooms.
ADMIN.WARN1: Do not deactivate your own admin account — you will lose access to the system.
ADMIN.NEXT1: After setup: add rooms → assign services → create staff → make a test appointment

DOCTOR.INTRO: The doctor has access only to their own patients and appointments.
DOCTOR.TIP1: Use the Dynamics tab to track patient indicators over time — great for chronic conditions.
DOCTOR.WARN1: Lab results ordered during an appointment are automatically linked to that patient.
DOCTOR.NEXT1: Check today's appointments on the dashboard → open patient card → fill in visit conclusions

RECEPTION.INTRO: Reception is responsible for patient registration and appointment booking.
RECEPTION.SEC1_DESC: In /patients → click Create Patient: first/last name, date of birth, contacts, address, blood type.
RECEPTION.SEC3_ITEM3: Laboratory — no doctor required + creates LabOrder
RECEPTION.TIP1: Use autocomplete in the patient search — type at least 2 characters of the first or last name.
RECEPTION.WARN1: If the time slot is occupied, the system will warn you. Pick a different time or doctor.
RECEPTION.NEXT1: Register a test patient → create an appointment for tomorrow → check that the notification arrives 2 hours before

RADIOLOGIST.INTRO: The radiologist works with DICOM images and prepares diagnostic reports.
RADIOLOGIST.SEC1_ITEM2: In Progress — currently being worked on
RADIOLOGIST.SEC2_ITEM1: Zoom / Pan — scale and move the image
RADIOLOGIST.SEC2_ITEM2: Window/Level — presets: Brain, Bone, Lung, Liver
RADIOLOGIST.SEC2_ITEM4: HU Value — tissue density at cursor point
RADIOLOGIST.SEC2_ITEM5: Annotations — add text labels to the image
RADIOLOGIST.SEC3_STEP1: Findings — describe what you see in the image
RADIOLOGIST.TIP1: Use Cine Mode (play button) to scroll through multi-frame series automatically.
RADIOLOGIST.WARN1: The Export PNG button saves the current frame with all overlaid measurements.
RADIOLOGIST.NEXT1: Open Worklist → find a Pending study → open DICOM Viewer → fill in report → mark Completed

LAB.INTRO: The lab technician processes test orders with automatic result interpretation.
LAB.SEC3_STEP1: Enter all parameter values → Save Results
LAB.SEC3_STEP3: The ordering doctor receives an automatic notification
LAB.TIP1: Critical results are highlighted in red — double-check them before marking the order complete.
LAB.WARN1: You cannot modify results after marking the order as Complete. Use caution.
LAB.NEXT1: Open Lab Worklist → pick a STAT order → enter values → review flags → complete

SYSTEM.SEC1_ITEM2: RIS — radiology with full DICOM viewer
SYSTEM.SEC3_ITEM3: Protected against SQL injection, XSS, JWT attacks

LANGUAGES.INTRO: The system supports 3 languages: Russian, Romanian, English.
LANGUAGES.SEC1_DESC: Click the language button in the top-right corner → dropdown menu. Your choice is saved in the browser.
LANGUAGES.SEC3_ITEM1: Patient names and medical history data
LANGUAGES.TIP1: Language preference is stored locally in your browser — each device remembers its own setting.

SECURITY.SEC2_ITEM1: Every endpoint is protected by JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard
SECURITY.SEC2_ITEM2: 5 roles: Admin / Doctor / Reception / Radiologist / Lab
SECURITY.SEC3_ITEM1: HS256 algorithm, 24-hour expiration, stored in localStorage
SECURITY.WARN1: Never share your access token or password with anyone, including other staff members.
